faq.question: What does wovain cost?
faq.answer: Nothing while in beta. Products are paid for by each sale through Fourthwall, and ad spend is your own daily budget, billed by Meta once you turn the campaign on.

faq.question: Will wovain spend money on ads by itself?
faq.answer: No. Every campaign is created paused. Spend starts only when you turn it on in Meta Ads Manager, at the daily budget you chose, from $1 to $500.

faq.question: Do I need a Fourthwall shop and a Meta ad account?
faq.answer: For a full drop, yes. You connect both after you sign up, in Connections. Trend research and designs work before you connect anything.

faq.question: How does wovain set prices?
faq.answer: From the blank's real base cost on Fourthwall: at least $10 profit and a 30% margin over the blank, after card fees, sales tax and a refund reserve, rounded up to a whole dollar.

faq.question: What does autopilot decide on its own?
faq.answer: NVIDIA Nemotron picks the idea and approves a design only when the check says it's ready, and stores its reason. Code still enforces the price floor, the budget range and the paused campaign.

faq.question: Who owns the designs?
faq.answer: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. wovain never prints the names Qloo matched and screens for trademarks, but you stay responsible for what you publish.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: wovain is a hackathon project. We keep as little as we can, and we never sell data.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email and password hash for your account; the briefs you write; and the runs, designs and products wovain makes for you.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use PostHog, hosted in the US, to learn how people find and use wovain: the pages you visit, what you click, page speed, the site's language and your country. Your country comes from your IP address, which isn't kept, and the page checks whether an automated browser is driving it, so bots aren't counted as visitors. Until you accept, it runs without cookies or browser storage, so it can't recognize you across visits or record replays. If you accept, or where the law doesn't require asking first, it stores an ID in your browser and records session replays, with everything you type and your account details hidden. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings at the bottom of the page, and a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser counts as a no. Once you sign in, these events are tied to your account's id, never your email.
privacy.connectionsBody: When you connect Fourthwall, Meta or fal, we store the access they grant so wovain can act for you. You can disconnect any of them at any time from Connections.
privacy.processorsBody: Briefs and designs are sent to the services that do the work: Nebius, Qloo, Tavily, fal, Fourthwall and Meta. Each handles data under its own policy.
privacy.deleteBody: Email privacy@wovain.com from your account's address and we delete your account, runs and stored connections within 30 days.

terms.intro: By using wovain you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: wovain is provided as is, during a hackathon, without warranty. Features may change or stop.
terms.contentBody: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. You are responsible for making sure what you publish does not infringe anyone's rights; wovain screens for trademarks but cannot guarantee it.
terms.spendBody: Campaigns are created paused. Any ad spend starts only when you turn a campaign on in Meta, and it is billed by Meta to your ad account.
